fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

First downloaded on 2026-09-24 at about 22:13Z and again at 22:31-22:33Z for the kept copy; re-downloaded at 2026-09-24T23:09Z, at least 30 minutes after the first, with matching byte count and SHA-256 (40166 bytes). The independent check downloaded it again at 2026-09-24T23:22-23:31Z with plain curl (no Accept-Encoding, no decoding), at least 49 minutes after the kept copy, with the same byte count and SHA-256; the base32 SHA-1 of the bytes equals the Internet Archive's CDX digest for the capture. The researcher's kept copy was re-hashed for this packet with the same result.

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: Closing the 53rd National Conference on 20 December 2012, Zuma, styled President, formally congratulates "the newly elected leadership of the ANC", the Officials and additional NEC members, says that "as the incoming leadership collective" they are humbled by the branches' confidence, and thanks the outgoing officials and NEC. He addresses Cyril Ramaphosa as "ANC Deputy President" and, separately, Kgalema Motlanthe as "Deputy President of the Republic" and former ANC Deputy President.

locator.section: Date line; salutation; paragraphs 3-5; paragraph beginning 'We discussed this critical matter with Deputy President Ramaphosa'

bounded_scope: ANC President observations for CLAUDE-C01-16 only (role za_anc_president on the AFRICAN NATIONAL CONGRESS observation). Conference election, publication of results, acceptance, handover speeches, departure statements, deputy and chair offices and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations are decided in the packet, not by any row.
